summary: Application for leave to appeal – review of arbitration award – test for leave to appeal under section 17(1) of Superior Courts Act – no reasonable prospects of success – application dismissed.
result: Order [21] In the result, the following order is made: 1. The application for leave to appeal is dismissed. 2. There is no order as to costs.
ai_summary: Summary: This case involves an application for leave to appeal brought by the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment against a judgment dismissing its application to review an arbitration award regarding the translation of Mr. Luthando Kiva to the Occupation Specific Dispensation (OSD). The Labour Court found no reasonable prospects of success on appeal and dismissed the application with no order as to costs.
